summary: All 28 distinct genes highlighted for wild-type scheduled versus unscheduled exercise in Figures 3C, S3 and S5 agreed in direction with the registered SCN output. Five of those 28 author-positive genes met the registered FDR < 0.05 cutoff. The proposal closes this selected-gene comparison without genome-wide sign-off. No ledger was edited. [Manuscript](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isci.2023.106002) · [Supplement](https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S2589004223000792-mmc1.pdf)
openIssues: The complete author DESeq2 table and fitting specification were unavailable. Exact effect magnitudes, per-gene P/FDR and genome-wide discovery overlap remain unassessed.

The Results and RNA-seq sample description label the same scheduled-exercise cohort CT22 and CT24, respectively. The sample identities are reconciled, but the precise circadian phase remains uncertain.
BioStudies served an unrelated clinical supplement under the expected filename. The comparison used the byte-identical publisher and PMC copies of Document S1.
